package_info.why_malicious: There is no evidence of intentional malicious behavior in this package. The package is flagged due to the presence of known security vulnerabilities (CVEs) in version 2.9.9.3, which could be exploited by attackers if left unpatched. The risk is due to exploitable flaws, not the presence of malicious code.

behavioral_signatures: Use of com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind version 2.9.9.3 or earlier, which contains known deserialization vulnerabilities exploitable via crafted input.
file_indicators: pom.xml or build.gradle files specifying dependency on com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.9.9.3
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan dependency manifests (e.g., pom.xml, build.gradle) for references to com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind version 2.9.9.3. Flag projects using this version for upgrade due to known CVEs. No malicious code is present, so detection focuses on identifying vulnerable versions and ensuring they are updated to secure releases as recommended by security advisories.
